title: USF-225 Browser Telemetry Faro Foundation Proof

browserAutomation.typescriptRuntimeCompatibility: TypeScript-compatible API used only from packages/proof/src/browser-telemetry-faro-proof.ts through a proof-local boundary and local Chromium executable.
browserAutomation.selectionRationale: Playwright Core is a maintained de-facto standard browser automation client. The core package avoids bundling browser binaries, works with the local Chromium executable, and keeps browser automation limited to the USF-225 proof harness.
alternativesRejected: Full Playwright package rejected because browser binary provisioning is unnecessary for this local proof.
Puppeteer rejected because Playwright Core is already suitable for deterministic multi-surface browser automation without product UI.
Shell-driven browser control rejected because an SDK/client boundary exists.

browserTelemetrySdk.typescriptRuntimeCompatibility: Official package with TypeScript types; browser IIFE bundle is served only by the transient proof server.
browserTelemetrySdk.selectionRationale: The package is the official Grafana Faro browser SDK and is suitable for bounded local browser telemetry capture without live ingestion, live provider credentials, or production telemetry claims.
alternativesRejected: Hand-rolled browser telemetry collection rejected because an official SDK exists.
Raw HTTP protocol emission rejected because the proof must exercise the SDK boundary.
OpenTelemetry browser-only substitute rejected because Faro itself can be initialized locally for this proof.

minimalHarnessScope.teardown: transient HTTP server, browser context, browser process, and temporary directory are closed or removed in finally paths

remainingDeferredBoundaries.nonClaimBoundary: USF-225 proves only a minimal telemetry harness and does not build product UI, React application delivery, component/page systems, broad browser E2E, or user journey parity.
USF-225 does not prove live Faro ingestion, production telemetry, live monitoring, alerting, dashboard, incident, staging, production, SOC, ISO, or enterprise production readiness.

negativeEvidence: No product UI, route/page/component architecture, visual snapshots, accessibility journeys, broad Playwright E2E, or React application delivery is created.

No live Faro ingestion, live monitoring, observability backend readiness, alerting, dashboard, incident response, staging, production, deployment, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full React parity, enterprise production readiness, or USF-133 closure evidence is produced.
REST/OpenAPI, local observability, and server-side telemetry evidence remain non-equivalent to browser telemetry capture unless the USF-225 proof command runs.
